### The work in Simone de Beauvoir’s thought

Simone de Beauvoir (1908–1986) was a French existentialist philosopher and novelist whose The Second Sex (1949) transformed feminist theory. A Normalienne, she partnered intellectually with Sartre while building an independent oeuvre on ethics, aging, and politics. [More on Simone de Beauvoir](https://www.philosophydef.com/thinkers/simone-de-beauvoir) .
